description: START HERE for a question about PostgreSQL. Searches every mailing list (inbox narrows it) with hybrid keyword + semantic ranking and returns cited passages that fit token_budget (default 4000, max 32000): one passage per thread (with author, up to 3 of that person's messages per thread), each the author's own words (quotes, signature and patch removed, cut at ~1200 chars) with url, inbox, message_id, from and date. found=false with a reason when the archive does not appear to discuss the question, instead of weak matches. Retrieval only: write the answer yourself. Cite each claim with its passage url or https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>; open a thread with get_thread. author, since and until restrict it to what one person wrote in a date window (filter echoes them). The question may carry search operators (after:2020, site:<list>); operators, warnings and skipped report what they did. complete=false when the search ran out of budget_ms. A commit SHA (7-40 hex) as the question returns the passages of the mail that refers to that commit, and commit. For "why was X added/changed/reverted" (no author, since or until, every list) it may also return commit_context beside the passages, never in them: the one commit the question resolved to (a SHA; for a code identifier, its first introduction by git log -S when the question asks why it was added, else the one commit whose subject names the question; or a Revert subject; a release the question names bounds it; resolved_by and matched say which) with its message (trailers removed, cut at ~500 tokens), states_reason (a rule's guess whether that message gives a reason relevant to the question), and up to 4 quoted sentences (whitespace collapsed) from its Discussion: threads with message_id, from and date. Check it is the commit you meant; get_commit or commit_history give the full commit. For what a person said or objected to ("what did X object to in Y", "who objected to what in this thread"), call said.

author.description: Only mail this person sent: name, address or hash:<8 hex>; every address they use. An ambiguous name returns the candidates

inbox.description: "all" (default), one list (pgsql-bugs) or several, comma-separated; names from list_inboxes

since.description: On or after (UTC): YYYY[-MM[-DD]], ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago

token_budget.description: Maximum tokens of evidence to return (default 4000, max 32000).

until.description: Before (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what they had said by then

name: retrieve_context
